blocks.zh: 法規合規（第二部分）：偏差管理與變更管理
blocks.en: Regulatory Compliance (Part 2): Deviation Management and Change Management

blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 了解疫情期間如何透過風險評估自主減輕偏差（Deviation）處理負擔，辨識哪些類型的偏差可合理簡化或合併。
blocks.en: Understand how risk assessment was used during the pandemic to self-ease the burden of handling deviations, and identify which types of deviation can reasonably be simplified or consolidated.

blocks.zh: 掌握法規承諾（Regulatory Commitment）與批准後承諾（Post-Approval Commitment, PAC）的定義與差異，以及疫情對其履行的衝擊。
blocks.en: Understand the definitions of and differences between a Regulatory Commitment and a Post-Approval Commitment (PAC), and the impact of the pandemic on fulfilling them.

blocks.zh: 理解 ICH Q12 確立條件（Established Conditions, EC）的法規意義，以及偏離 EC 時的申報義務。
blocks.en: Understand the regulatory significance of ICH Q12 Established Conditions (EC) and the reporting obligations when departing from an EC.

blocks.zh: 評估各主要監管機構（FDA、EMA、MHRA、WHO）在疫情期間提供的彈性措施，並辨識其適用條件。
blocks.en: Evaluate the flexibility measures offered by the major regulators (FDA, EMA, MHRA, WHO) during the pandemic and identify the conditions under which they apply.

blocks.zh: 學習如何依 SISPQ / SQuIPP 風險框架對變更提交進行優先排序，以及分組（Bundling/Grouping）申報的策略。
blocks.en: Learn how to prioritize change submissions using the SISPQ / SQuIPP risk frameworks, and the strategy of bundling/grouping submissions.

blocks.zh: Q4-4  —  How can the industry self-ease the burden of handling deviations?  （產業如何自主減輕偏差處理負擔？）
blocks.en: Q4-4 — How can the industry self-ease the burden of handling deviations? (How can industry self-ease the burden of handling deviations?)

blocks.zh: 中文解析
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：什麼是「Self-Easement（自主減輕）」？
blocks.en: Core Concept: What Is "Self-Easement"?

blocks.zh: Self-easement 並非放棄 GMP 要求，而是在維持產品品質保護的前提下，對低風險偏差採取更有效率的處理方式。疫情期間偏差數量激增，若每一件都按一般程序走，品保人力將完全癱瘓。
blocks.en: Self-easement does not mean giving up GMP requirements; it means handling low-risk deviations more efficiently while keeping product quality protected. During the pandemic the number of deviations surged, and if every one had followed the normal procedure, quality assurance staff would have been completely paralyzed.

blocks.zh: 核心邏輯：依偏差對產品品質的影響程度分類處理，而不是一視同仁地消耗相同資源。
blocks.en: Core logic: handle deviations by category according to their impact on product quality, rather than spending the same resources on every one.

blocks.zh: 比喻：醫院急診的分流（Triage）
blocks.en: Analogy: Triage in a Hospital Emergency Room

blocks.zh: 就像急診室不會讓骨折病人和輕微擦傷病人排同一條隊，偏差管理也需要「分流」——高風險偏差（影響無菌性、含量、穩定性）優先處理，低風險偏差（低關鍵度潔淨室的 EM 結果、非關鍵設備校驗延遲）採用簡化流程。
blocks.en: Just as an emergency room does not put a fracture patient and a minor graze in the same queue, deviation management also needs "triage": high-risk deviations (affecting sterility, content or stability) are handled first, while low-risk deviations (EM results from low-criticality cleanrooms, delayed calibration of non-critical equipment) follow a simplified process.

blocks.zh: 八項自主減輕措施——CDMO 視角解讀
blocks.en: Eight Self-Easement Measures: A CDMO Perspective

blocks.zh: 擴大偏差範圍（Scope Expansion）：同類型的多起偏差合併為一件，減少重複調查。例如：同一供應商多批原料延遲，合併為一件偏差記錄。
blocks.en: Scope Expansion: consolidate multiple deviations of the same type into one to reduce duplicate investigations. Example: delays in several batches of raw material from the same supplier are combined into a single deviation record.

blocks.zh: 臨時變更控制（Temporary Change Control）：對微小操作調整以 TCC 取代完整偏差流程，在受控記錄下快速推進。
blocks.en: Temporary Change Control (TCC): for minor operational adjustments, use a TCC instead of the full deviation process, moving quickly under a controlled record.

blocks.zh: 程序適用性評估：現有的偏差調查 SOP 是否適用緊急情境？必要時先更新程序本身。
blocks.en: Procedure applicability assessment: is the existing deviation investigation SOP suitable for an emergency situation? If necessary, update the procedure itself first.

blocks.zh: 延遲 / 縮減檢測：針對有歷史數據支撐的低關鍵度項目（例如低風險區 EM、成熟藥品穩定性），在有科學依據的條件下可縮減頻率。
blocks.en: Delayed / reduced testing: for low-criticality items supported by historical data (for example EM in low-risk areas, stability of mature products), the frequency may be reduced where scientifically justified.

blocks.zh: 遠端供應商稽核：無法親赴現場時，改用書面審查或視訊稽核，並更新品質協議（Quality Agreement）以反映此安排。
blocks.en: Remote supplier audits: when on-site visits are not possible, use a paper-based review or a video audit, and update the Quality Agreement to reflect the arrangement.

blocks.zh: 設備回溯評估（Retrospective Evaluation）：已使用但未事前驗證的設備，以回溯方式評估其效能是否符合要求。
blocks.en: Retrospective Evaluation of equipment: for equipment that has been used without prior qualification, evaluate retrospectively whether its performance meets requirements.

blocks.zh: 遠端技術支援：維修工程師無法到場時，允許遠端協助模式，並留存完整記錄。
blocks.en: Remote technical support: when service engineers cannot be on site, allow a remote assistance mode and keep complete records.

blocks.zh: 預防性維護 / 校驗延遲：在風險評估支持下，允許非關鍵設施的 PM / 校驗延後執行。
blocks.en: Delayed preventive maintenance / calibration: supported by a risk assessment, allow PM / calibration of non-critical facilities to be postponed.

blocks.zh: CDMO 重點提示
blocks.en: Key Points for CDMOs

blocks.zh: CDMO 在緊急情況下往往同時管理數十位客戶的品質系統。BCP（業務持續計畫）應預先設定「緊急偏差分類標準」，明確定義哪些偏差可走簡化路徑、哪些必須維持完整調查。此標準需經過客戶同意並寫入品質協議，否則在審計時可能引發爭議。
blocks.en: In an emergency, a CDMO often manages the quality systems of dozens of clients at the same time. The BCP (business continuity plan) should define "emergency deviation classification criteria" in advance, specifying which deviations may follow a simplified path and which must keep a full investigation. These criteria need the clients' agreement and should be written into the Quality Agreement; otherwise they may cause disputes during an audit.

blocks.zh: 思考練習
blocks.en: Exercise

blocks.zh: 假設你的工廠在疫情期間同時收到 50 件偏差，其中 35 件來自人力不足導致的文件延遲、10 件來自原料到貨延誤、5 件涉及環境監控超標。請問你會如何分流？哪些可以合併？哪些需要完整的 CAPA？
blocks.en: Suppose your site receives 50 deviations at the same time during the pandemic: 35 from document delays caused by staff shortages, 10 from delayed raw material deliveries, and 5 involving environmental monitoring excursions. How would you triage them? Which can be consolidated? Which need a full CAPA?

blocks.zh: Q4-5  —  How do you make sure that commitments are met, reported, and documented with deviations?  （如何確保承諾在偏差情況下仍被履行、申報與記錄？）
blocks.en: Q4-5 — How do you make sure that commitments are met, reported, and documented with deviations? (How do you make sure commitments are still fulfilled, reported and documented when deviations occur?)

blocks.zh: ICH Q12 確立條件（Established Conditions, EC）
blocks.en: ICH Q12 Established Conditions (EC)

blocks.zh: EC 是 ICH Q12 的核心概念：所有對產品品質具有法律約束力的製程與管制資訊，若有任何變動，必須向主管機關提交申請（類似 EMA 的 Variation）。
blocks.en: EC is the core concept of ICH Q12: for all legally binding process and control information that affects product quality, any change must be submitted to the competent authority (similar to an EMA Variation).

blocks.zh: 疫情期間若工廠因應緊急情況而偏離了 EC（例如更換原料來源、調整製程參數），即使出於善意，仍需主動聯繫相關 NRA 申請豁免或減輕申報要求。
blocks.en: If, during the pandemic, a site departed from an EC in response to an emergency (for example changing a raw material source or adjusting process parameters), even with good intentions it must still proactively contact the relevant NRA to request a waiver or reduced reporting requirements.

blocks.zh: 比喻：承諾清單就像婚前協議
blocks.en: Analogy: The Commitment List Is Like a Prenuptial Agreement

blocks.zh: 法規承諾寫在藥品許可證裡，就像白紙黑字的合約——你必須按照承諾的方式製藥。PAC 則像「婚後補件」，核准時還沒完成、但已承諾主管機關會在特定期限內補交。疫情讓這些承諾的執行時程全部被打亂，各國主管機關因此開始允許「暫停時鐘（Freezing）」和「回滾（Rolling Back）」程序。
blocks.en: Regulatory commitments are written into the marketing authorization like a contract in black and white: you must manufacture the drug in the way you committed to. A PAC is more like "documents to be supplied after the wedding": it was not completed at approval, but you promised the authority to submit it within a specified time. The pandemic disrupted the timelines for all of these commitments, so authorities in various countries began to allow "Freezing" (clock-stop) and "Rolling Back" procedures.

blocks.zh: CDMO 重點提示：QP 聲明與品質責任
blocks.en: Key Points for CDMOs: QP Declaration and Quality Responsibility

blocks.zh: 對歐洲市場的 CDMO 而言，QP（合格人員）聲明是每批放行的法定要求。疫情期間 EMA 允許以「書面稽核」替代現場稽核，但 QP 必須：
blocks.en: For CDMOs serving the European market, the QP (Qualified Person) declaration is a legal requirement for every batch release. During the pandemic EMA allowed "paper-based audits" to replace on-site audits, but the QP must:

blocks.zh: 提供科學依據，說明替代控制措施的合理性。
blocks.en: Provide scientific justification explaining why the alternative control measures are reasonable.

blocks.zh: 針對每個特定產品進行風險評估並留存記錄。
blocks.en: Perform a risk assessment for each specific product and keep the records.

blocks.zh: 確保這些替代措施不會損及活性物質的適用性及藥品的安全性與效能。
blocks.en: Ensure that these alternative measures do not compromise the suitability of the active substance or the safety and efficacy of the medicinal product.

blocks.zh: 這意味著 CDMO 的 QP 必須有能力做出獨立的風險判斷，而非單純依賴客戶的說法。
blocks.en: This means the CDMO's QP must be able to make an independent risk judgment rather than simply relying on the client's statements.

blocks.zh: 教訓：早期行動的重要性
blocks.en: Lesson: The Importance of Early Action

blocks.zh: PDA 的核心教訓是：疫情初期的遲緩回應造成了最大的供應中斷。若監管機構和業界能更早建立緊急彈性機制，大量藥品短缺本可避免。未來的 BCP 應預先包含「在何種條件下可申請哪些法規彈性」的標準作業流程，而不是等到危機爆發才臨時協商。
blocks.en: PDA's core lesson is that the slow response in the early days of the pandemic caused the greatest supply interruptions. Had regulators and industry set up emergency flexibility mechanisms earlier, many drug shortages could have been avoided. Future BCPs should include in advance a standard procedure for "which regulatory flexibilities can be requested under which conditions", rather than negotiating ad hoc after the crisis breaks out.

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 客戶在疫情期間通知你：他們的 QP 聲明所需的現場稽核因旅遊限制而無法執行。你作為 CDMO 的品保主管，應如何協助客戶準備「書面稽核（Paper-based Audit）」的資料包，以符合 EMA 的案例評估要求？需要哪些文件？誰負責最終的風險評估？
blocks.en: During the pandemic your CDMO client tells you that the on-site audit needed for their QP declaration cannot be carried out because of travel restrictions. As the CDMO's head of quality assurance, how would you help the client prepare a data package for a "paper-based audit" that meets EMA's case-by-case assessment expectations? Which documents are needed? Who is responsible for the final risk assessment?

blocks.zh: Q4-6  —  How do you prioritize submissions of changes in process during the pandemic?  （疫情期間如何優先排序製程變更的申報？）
blocks.en: Q4-6 — How do you prioritize submissions of changes in process during the pandemic? (How should submissions of process changes be prioritized during the pandemic?)

blocks.zh: SISPQ 與 SQuIPP 風險評估框架
blocks.en: SISPQ and SQuIPP Risk Assessment Frameworks

blocks.zh: 這兩個縮寫是業界用來評估製程或變更對藥品的潛在影響的標準框架：
blocks.en: These two acronyms are standard frameworks used by industry to assess the potential impact of a process or change on the drug product:

blocks.zh: SISPQ：Safety（安全性）、Integrity（完整性）、Strength（強度/效價）、Purity（純度）、Quality（品質）
blocks.en: SISPQ: Safety, Integrity, Strength, Purity, Quality

blocks.zh: SQuIPP：Safety（安全性）、Quality（品質）、Integrity（完整性）、Purity（純度）、Potency（效力）
blocks.en: SQuIPP: Safety, Quality, Integrity, Purity, Potency

blocks.zh: 評估結果決定申報路徑：無影響 → 內部 PQS 記錄；輕微影響 → 通知申報；重大影響 → 事前審批。
blocks.en: The assessment result determines the reporting pathway: no impact → internal PQS record; minor impact → notification; major impact → prior approval.

blocks.zh: 比喻：分組申報就像團購
blocks.en: Analogy: Grouped Submissions Are Like Group Buying

blocks.zh: 疫苗 MAH 在疫情期間採用的「Bundling（分組）」策略，就像把原本要分開下的訂單合併成一張採購單——對主管機關來說，審查一個大型申請包，比審查 20 個小申請效率高得多。歐盟 ICMRA 的數據顯示，COVID-19 疫苗申請人成功地將數十項 PAC 合併為少數幾個提交包，大幅壓縮了審查週期。
blocks.en: The "Bundling" strategy adopted by vaccine MAHs during the pandemic is like merging orders that would have been placed separately into one purchase order: for the authority, reviewing one large submission package is far more efficient than reviewing 20 small ones. ICMRA data from the EU show that COVID-19 vaccine applicants successfully combined dozens of PACs into a few submission packages, greatly shortening review timelines.

blocks.zh: 三種加速申報工具
blocks.en: Three Tools to Accelerate Submissions

blocks.zh: 矩陣法（Matrix Approach）：對於組合疫苗等多品項產品，透過統計設計合理減少需要驗證的批次數量，降低物料消耗的同時加快提交速度。
blocks.en: Matrix Approach: for multi-presentation products such as combination vaccines, a statistical design reasonably reduces the number of batches that need to be validated, lowering material consumption while speeding up submission.

blocks.zh: ICH Q12 穩定性資料方法（Chapters 8 & 9）：利用已建立的穩定性模型預測，減少新批次必須提交的穩定性數據量。
blocks.en: ICH Q12 stability data approach (Chapters 8 & 9): use established stability model predictions to reduce the amount of stability data that new batches must submit.

blocks.zh: 確立條件（EC）機制：預先與主管機關約定哪些製程參數的變更可以走快速通道（Change Management Protocol），避免每次都從零開始談判。
blocks.en: Established Conditions (EC) mechanism: agree in advance with the authority which process parameter changes can use a fast track (Change Management Protocol), avoiding negotiation from zero each time.

blocks.zh: CDMO 重點提示：早期主動接觸主管機關
blocks.en: Key Points for CDMOs: Engage Authorities Early and Proactively

blocks.zh: PDA 特別強調：MAH 應在問題發生前就主動聯繫主管機關，了解其期望與彈性空間。對 CDMO 而言，這意味著：
blocks.en: PDA specifically emphasizes that MAHs should contact the authority proactively before problems occur, to understand its expectations and room for flexibility. For a CDMO, this means:

blocks.zh: 協助客戶預先建立「緊急變更管理協議（Emergency Change Management Protocol）」，取得主管機關的預先同意。
blocks.en: Help clients set up an "Emergency Change Management Protocol" in advance and obtain the authority's prior agreement.

blocks.zh: 維護各主要市場（EU、US、Taiwan、日本）的法規彈性措施清單，隨時更新。
blocks.en: Maintain a list of regulatory flexibility measures for each main market (EU, US, Taiwan, Japan) and keep it current.

blocks.zh: 在 CAPA 關閉率和 PAC 追蹤上維持高透明度，避免稽核時出現意外。
blocks.en: Maintain high transparency on CAPA closure rates and PAC tracking to avoid surprises during audits.

blocks.zh: CAPA（糾正與預防措施）關閉率是 GMP 稽查的核心指標之一。在緊急情況下，因偏差激增而導致 CAPA 積壓，是典型的稽查觀察項。
blocks.en: The CAPA closure rate is one of the core indicators in a GMP inspection. In an emergency, a CAPA backlog caused by a surge of deviations is a typical inspection observation.

blocks.zh: WHO 多市場同步申報策略
blocks.en: WHO Multi-Market Simultaneous Submission Strategy

blocks.zh: 對需要在多個市場同時上市的 CDMO 客戶，WHO 提供了統一的變更申報框架（TRS No. 966, 993, 1011），允許：
blocks.en: For CDMO clients who need to launch in several markets at the same time, WHO provides a unified change reporting framework (TRS No. 966, 993, 1011), which allows:

blocks.zh: 無 SISPQ 影響的變更：只需在 PQS 中記錄，無需向主管機關申報。
blocks.en: Changes with no SISPQ impact: only need to be recorded in the PQS, with no submission to the authority.

blocks.zh: 輕微變更（生物製劑）：可先實施，在規定時間內通知主管機關即可。
blocks.en: Minor changes (biologicals): may be implemented first, with notification to the authority within the specified time.

blocks.zh: 中等 / 重大變更：可以分組（Bundle）並依相似性或執行順序交錯申報，減少提交次數。
blocks.en: Moderate / major changes: may be bundled and submitted in a staggered way according to similarity or order of implementation, reducing the number of submissions.

blocks.zh: 假設你的 CDMO 客戶有一個非疫情相關的無菌注射劑，在疫情期間積累了以下待申報變更：(1) 更換一種輔料供應商、(2) 調整滅菌條件參數、(3) 更新標籤格式。請用 SISPQ 框架評估這三項變更的優先順序，並決定哪些可以合併申報、哪些需要個別提交。
blocks.en: Suppose your CDMO client has a sterile injectable unrelated to the pandemic that accumulated the following pending changes during the pandemic: (1) changing an excipient supplier, (2) adjusting sterilization condition parameters, (3) updating the label format. Use the SISPQ framework to assess the priority of these three changes and decide which can be submitted together and which need individual submissions.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：疫情期間的雙軌挑戰
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Dual-Track Challenge of the Pandemic

blocks.zh: 疫情創造了兩個截然不同的壓力場景，對 MAH 和 CDMO 產生了相反方向的壓力：
blocks.en: The pandemic created two very different pressure scenarios that pushed MAHs and CDMOs in opposite directions:

blocks.zh: Section Summary  |  本節摘要
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 核心結論（中文）
blocks.en: Key Conclusions

blocks.zh: 偏差自主減輕的關鍵是建立風險分流機制：依對產品品質的影響程度分類，低風險偏差可合併或走簡化流程，但必須有科學依據支撐。
blocks.en: The key to self-easing deviations is a risk triage mechanism: classify by impact on product quality; low-risk deviations may be consolidated or follow a simplified process, but this must be supported by scientific justification.

blocks.zh: 法規承諾（Dossier 中的承諾）與批准後承諾（PAC）必須分別追蹤管理；ICH Q12 的確立條件（EC）則構成第三層法律約束。
blocks.en: Regulatory commitments (commitments in the dossier) and post-approval commitments (PAC) must be tracked and managed separately; ICH Q12 Established Conditions (EC) form a third layer of legal obligation.

blocks.zh: 疫情期間各主管機關（EMA、MHRA、FDA）皆給予彈性，但都是有條件的個案豁免，而非全面放寬 GMP 要求。
blocks.en: During the pandemic, authorities (EMA, MHRA, FDA) all gave flexibility, but only as conditional case-by-case waivers, not a general relaxation of GMP requirements.

blocks.zh: SISPQ / SQuIPP 風險評估框架是變更申報優先排序的標準工具；分組（Bundling）申報可大幅降低審查負擔並加快核准。
blocks.en: The SISPQ / SQuIPP risk assessment frameworks are the standard tools for prioritizing change submissions; bundling submissions can greatly reduce review burden and speed up approval.

blocks.zh: 本節最重要的教訓：在緊急情況發生前主動建立彈性機制、與主管機關早期溝通，是減少供應中斷的最有效手段。
blocks.en: The most important lesson of this section: building flexibility mechanisms and communicating early with authorities before an emergency occurs is the most effective way to reduce supply interruptions.
